item.title: Abbott Libre Duo: FDA‑Approved 2‑in‑1 CGM for Diabetes
item.description: Abbott’s Libre Duo is the first FDA‑cleared 2‑in‑1 CGM, pairing glucose tracking with optional sensor data to tighten diabetes management for patients.
